description_en: Queries the settlement bills of a user within a specific billing cycle
description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的结算账单
name: QueryBill

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle, in the YYYY-MM format
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The type. Valid values:
SubscriptionOrder
PayAsYouGoBill
Refund
Adjustment
parameters.help_zh:
类型。取值：
SubscriptionOrder
PayAsYouGoBill
Refund
Adjustment
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:
Subscription
PayAsYouGo

This parameter must be used together with the ProductCode parameter
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值：
Subscription
PayAsYouGo

必须和ProductCode参数一起使用
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter out bills with a original price (PretaxGrossAmount) of 0. Default value: false (compatible with existing logic). Valid values:
true: filters out zero-charge bills.
false: does not filter out zero-charge bills
parameters.help_zh:
根据原价（PretaxGrossAmount）是否为0做过滤，默认为否（兼容现有逻辑）。
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: is_hide_zero_charge

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，默认值：20，最大值：300
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource ownership account. The resource ownership account is the account that actually uses the resource
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号的ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
